sections.name: A ruling, one tap, to save your hands (your pick A in chat, 18:24): the builder alone, never a helper, may also click in the Epic Games Launcher (already signed in) and on fab.com in your Chrome, only to (1) download items already in your Fab library, (2) press 'Add to My Library' on free items an adopted order names, (3) install Unreal engine updates and optional components (never the debugging symbols). Never buy, sign in, create accounts, accept paid terms or change account settings; each use one line in DECISIONS.
